tools.name: check_solana_token
tools.description: Scam/rug risk check for a Solana SPL or Token-2022 token mint. Returns a 0-100 risk score (HIGHER = RISKIER), a verdict, and flags with plain-English reasons: mint/freeze authority, permanent delegate, transfer hooks/fees, holder concentration, liquidity, LP burn/lock %, Streamflow locks and a simul

tools.name: deep_check_solana_token
tools.description: Deep Solana token risk check (PAID, x402 over REST): holder concentration (top1/top5/top10 % of supply), top wallets linked by a shared funder (bundles/insiders), creator-funded holders, fresh wallets, LP lock/burn status, authorities, score + reasons. This tool returns exact x402 payment instructio

tools.name: batch_check_solana_tokens
tools.description: Batch Solana token risk check (PAID, x402 over REST): up to 20 mints in one call for one flat price. This tool returns exact x402 payment instructions for POST /v1/paid/batch-check.

tools.name: diff_solana_token
tools.description: Watch/diff a Solana token: pass the mint and a previous Haris result (from check_solana_token or an earlier diff); returns alerts on what changed (authority re-enabled, LP unlocked, liquidity pulled, sell blocked, new red flags) plus the fresh result. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: deep_check_solana_token, batch_check_solana_tokens · Private data: check_solana_token, deep_check_solana_token, batch_check_solana_tokens, diff_solana_token · Public sink: deep_check_solana_token, batch_check_solana_tokens, diff_solana_token.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: deep_check_solana_token, batch_check_solana_tokens · Private data: check_solana_token, deep_check_solana_token, batch_check_solana_tokens, diff_solana_token · Public sink: deep_check_solana_token, batch_check_solana_tokens, diff_solana_token

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
